verdicts.rationale: Although L77 concatenates targetdir and 'bin/', the in-file entry point fixes targetdir to '/htdocs/xbeach/testbed/' at L150 and passes it unchanged at L164-L169. That trailing slash neutralizes the alleged malformed destination on the script's actual call path; a failure would require a different external caller.

L57 inserts source directly into a single-quoted TeamCity message without any escaping; source comes from globbed paths or workdir-derived workhtml, and neither caller sanitizes it. A path containing an apostrophe or service-message control character can therefore corrupt the emitted message.

The event-ID calls at L60-L64 repeatedly overwrite ierr without testing it, and the description and event-logging calls follow the same pattern throughout the program. Numerical reduction and result printing at L124-L133 proceed independently of those statuses, so a returned logging failure is not propagated or reported by this example.

verdicts.rationale: Event-ID, description, event-logging and clock-sync return values are discarded, and the explicit MPE_Finish_log return is also ignored when NO_MPI_LOGGING is defined. That preprocessor condition only selects explicit initialization/finalization; it does not guard the other unchecked calls or prevent numerical output followed by return(0) at L124-L131 after a returned logging error.

L41 initializes pp as a numeric empty array, then L43 assigns a plot handle into it by indexed assignment; the same pattern recurs at L59-L64 and L87-L92. There is no graphics-object preallocation or version guard, so these assignments are incompatible with MATLAB versions whose plot returns graphics objects instead of numeric handles.
